story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to record the equipment required for an event so that Technical Support Staff can assess whether the requested resources can be provided

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can specify the equipment type.
The Event Coordinator can specify the required quantity.
The Event Coordinator can specify relevant technical requirements.
For a multi-session event, equipment requirements can be recorded per session, since different sessions may need different equipment.
Equipment requirements are associated with the event (and session, where applicable).
Technical Support Staff can view the requirements.
Equipment requirements can be updated during planning where authorised.

test_cases.title: Coordinator records an equipment requirement with a type, quantity, and technical requirements
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Hui Shan Neo (huishan.neo@connectsphere.com / password123), the Coordinator assigned to 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference' (status Planning, 14 Dec 2026 09:00-17:00, organised by Samuel Ong).
The event already has '4K Portable Projector' (Quantity 4) and 'Portable WiFi Access Point' (Quantity 4) for the whole event, and 'Audio Mixing Desk' (Quantity 1) for its 'Morning briefing' session.
test_cases.steps:
1. Open 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'
2. Click the 'Equipment' tab
3. In 'Add equipment', open the 'Equipment' dropdown and choose 'Handheld Wireless Mic'
4. Set 'Quantity' to 6
5. Enter 'Lapel mics for panel speakers.' in 'Technical requirements'
6. Click 'Add'
test_cases.test_data: Equipment: Handheld Wireless Mic | Quantity: 6 | Technical requirements: Lapel mics for panel speakers.
test_cases.expected_result:
A new row for 'Handheld Wireless Mic' appears showing Quantity 6 and 'Lapel mics for panel speakers.', with status 'Requested'.
The existing '4K Portable Projector' row (Quantity 4) is unchanged.
The Add equipment fields reset to their defaults.

execution.actual_result:
A new row for 'Handheld Wireless Mic' appears showing Quantity 6 and 'Lapel mics for panel speakers.', with status 'Requested'.
The existing '4K Portable Projector' row (Quantity 4) is unchanged.
The Add equipment fields reset to their defaults.

test_cases.title: A recorded requirement stays associated with its own event and does not appear on a different event
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Hui Shan Neo (huishan.neo@connectsphere.com / password123), Coordinator of 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'.
That event has a requirement for '4K Portable Projector', Quantity 4.
A second event, 'Straits Medical Research Symposium' (Coordinator: Daniel Tan), has its own, different equipment (LED Video Wall Panel, PTZ Streaming Camera, Audio Mixing Desk, Hearing Loop Receiver Kit, Lavalier Wireless Mic) but no '4K Portable Projector'.
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the 'Equipment' tab of 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'
2. Refresh the page
3. Confirm the '4K Portable Projector' row is still present
4. Log out and log in as Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123)
5. Open the 'Equipment' tab of 'Straits Medical Research Symposium'
test_cases.test_data: Event A: Pearl Delta Safety Conference | Event B: Straits Medical Research Symposium
test_cases.expected_result:
On 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference', the '4K Portable Projector' row is still shown after reloading.
On 'Straits Medical Research Symposium', the equipment list shows only that event's own five items; '4K Portable Projector' does not appear.

execution.actual_result:
On 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference', the '4K Portable Projector' row is still shown after reloading.
On 'Straits Medical Research Symposium', the equipment list shows only that event's own five items; '4K Portable Projector' does not appear.

test_cases.title: Technical Support Staff can view a Coordinator's recorded requirements on the event
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Kenji Sato (kenji.sato@connectsphere.com / password123), Technical Support.
'Pearl Delta Safety Conference' has a requirement for '4K Portable Projector', Quantity 4, technical requirements 'Four demonstration stations.'.
test_cases.steps:
1. Open 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'
2. Click the 'Equipment' tab
test_cases.expected_result:
The '4K Portable Projector' row is shown with Requested quantity 4, technical requirements 'Four demonstration stations.', and status 'Under review' — quantity and technical requirements as plain text, not an input field.
No 'Save', 'Remove', or 'Add equipment' section are shown — the same read-only view as the Organiser gets.

execution.actual_result:
The '4K Portable Projector' row is shown with Requested quantity 4, technical requirements 'Four demonstration stations.', and status 'Requested' — quantity and technical requirements as plain text, not an input field.
No 'Save', 'Remove', or 'Add equipment' section are shown — the same read-only view as the Organiser gets.

test_cases.title: Organiser sees the same requirements read-only and cannot edit them
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Samuel Ong (samuel.ong@pearldeltama.com / password123), the Organiser of 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'.
The event has a requirement for '4K Portable Projector', Quantity 4.
Note: this is broader than AC6's literal wording ('Technical Support Staff can view the requirements') — the Organiser also gets read-only visibility into their own event's equipment, because they reasonably want to see what's been recorded against the event they raised (see canViewEquipmentRequests in src/lib/permissions.ts).
test_cases.steps:
1. Open 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference' from 'My Events'
2. Click the 'Equipment' tab
test_cases.expected_result:
The '4K Portable Projector' row is visible with its quantity and technical requirements shown as plain text (not an input field of any kind).
There is no editable Quantity or Technical requirements field, no 'Save' or 'Remove' button, and no 'Add equipment' section.

execution.actual_result:
The '4K Portable Projector' row is visible with its quantity and technical requirements shown as plain text (not an input field of any kind).
There is no editable Quantity or Technical requirements field, no 'Save' or 'Remove' button, and no 'Add equipment' section.

A requirement was recorded for the event while it was still in Planning, and the event's status has since been set to Cancelled. Both are seeded by `npx prisma db seed`: the requirement is '4K Portable Projector', Quantity 2 (there is no in-app 'Cancel event' action yet).

A banner reads 'This event is cancelled — equipment requirements can no longer be changed.'
The existing row is shown, but with no editable fields, no 'Save' or 'Remove' button, and no 'Add equipment' section, even though the viewer is the Coordinator.

A banner reads 'This event is cancelled — equipment requirements can no longer be changed.'
The existing row is shown, but with no editable fields, no 'Save' or 'Remove' button, and no 'Add equipment' section, even though the viewer is the Coordinator.

test_cases.title: Coordinator scopes equipment requirements to individual sessions of a multi-session event
test_cases.preconditions:
Logged in as Hui Shan Neo (huishan.neo@connectsphere.com / password123), Coordinator of 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'.
The event has two sessions: 'Morning briefing' (09:00-12:00) and 'Afternoon workshop' (13:00-17:00), both on 14 Dec 2026. There is no in-app way to add a session to an existing event, so both sessions are seeded by `npx prisma db seed`.
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the 'Equipment' tab of 'Pearl Delta Safety Conference'
2. In 'Add equipment', choose 'Gooseneck Table Mic', set Quantity to 1, and choose 'Morning briefing' in the new 'Session' dropdown
3. Click 'Add'
4. Choose 'Powered Speaker', set Quantity to 2, and choose 'Afternoon workshop' in 'Session'
5. Click 'Add'
test_cases.test_data: Session dropdown options: Whole event, Morning briefing, Afternoon workshop | Row 1: Gooseneck Table Mic / Morning briefing | Row 2: Powered Speaker / Afternoon workshop
test_cases.expected_result:
Both rows are added, each showing a small label naming its session ('Morning briefing' / 'Afternoon workshop') next to the equipment name.
Each requirement is independent — Technical Support reviewing 'Afternoon workshop' sees only the Powered Speaker request, not the Gooseneck Table Mic one.

execution.actual_result:
Both rows are added, each showing a small label naming its session ('Morning briefing' / 'Afternoon workshop') next to the equipment name.
Each requirement is independent — Technical Support reviewing 'Afternoon workshop' sees only the Powered Speaker request, not the Gooseneck Table Mic one.
